snippet.title: Berserk B.I.T.S - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
An official trailer for idle-RPG Berserk B.I.T.S, which showcases an updated look at the game, with new Battle Chips in play. There's a new demo out now on Steam, and the game is also available to Wishlist. It launches later this year on PC. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #beserkbits 

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
